verbalization: Hypocrellol B is implicated in the targeting of CDK3/cyclin E, which in turn is a target of multiple compounds, including (2S,3S)-2-(5-Methoxy-3,4-Methylenedioxybenzyl)-3-(3,4-Methylenedioxybenzyl)Butyrolactone, Agelasidine C, and Dihydropinosylvin. All these compounds are linked to the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1, suggesting a common mechanism of action involving CDK3/cyclin E. The evidence indicates that Hypocrellol B may act through a pathway that involves CDK3/cyclin E, which is a target of several compounds that ultimately interact with Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1. The integration of these pathways highlights a potential role for CDK3/cyclin E in mediating the effects of these compounds on the transporter, underscoring a recurring mechanism of targeting the transporter via a downstream effector molecule. The evidence supports a plausible link between Hypocrellol B and Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1 through a chain of targets involving CDK3/cyclin E.
